{{Quote|The main reason for creating this piece was to show Vader leading his troops into battle. I wanted to actually ''show him'' in the midst of his beloved 501st Squad, being the leader he was ''born'' to be.|Dave Dorman, on his painting|<ref name="Anatomy" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fought a '''battle''' on an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|The two most confusing elements of ''Lord Vader's Persuasion'' are the inclusion of the Imperial Guards (the red armored figures surrounding Vader) and the fact that Vader is rising above the squad.|Dave Dorman, on his painting|<ref name="Anatomy" />}}
At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] invaded a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The operation was carried out by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and was personally led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Anatomy" />

The invasion force included [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guardsmen]], as well as [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. Leading his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] directly from the front, Vader surrounded himself with a group of Imperial Guards, while stormtroopers of the 501st Legion formed a phalanx around them.<ref name="Anatomy" />

During the course of the battle, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] used the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Levitation|levitate]] himself above his troops. Knowing that he would become his opponents' primary target, he also used the Force to [[Force deflection/Legends|deflect]] enemy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.<ref name="Anatomy" />

Rising above the fray as a powerful leading figure, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] inspired his troops to push forward towards victory. As a result of the battle, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader effectively managed to persuade the Outer Rim world to join the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Anatomy" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This art has caught the imagination of Star Wars fans around the world, and has inspired me to create other scenes capturing potential story elements that were not in the screenplays, but are part of the canon of the Star Wars history.|Dave Dorman, on his painting|<ref name="Anatomy" />}}
The [[:File:Lord-vaders-persuasion.jpg|painting]] that featured this battle was created by [[Dave Dorman]] and exhibited at [[Celebration IV]], the fourth [[Celebration]] of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' saga, which was held in [[Wikipedia:Los Angeles|Los Angeles]], [[Wikipedia:California|California]] from [[May 24]] to [[May 28]], [[2007]].<ref name="Illustration" />

It was later published in the [[2012]] art book ''[[Star Wars Art: Illustration]]'' under the title ''Lord Vader's Persuasion of the Outer Rim World''.<ref name="Illustration" />

In [[2013]], the painting was used by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] to illustrate the card "Lord Vader's Command" in ''[[The Desolation of Hoth]]'', the first Force Pack in ''The Hoth Cycle'' of ''[[Star Wars: The Card Game]]''.<ref name="TDoH">{{FFGTCG|set=The Desolation of Hoth|cardname=Lord Vader's Command}}</ref>

In [[2015]], Dorman posted an [https://davedorman.wordpress.com/2015/02/10/a-short-anatomy-of-my-star-wars-painting-lord-vaders-persuasion article] on his [https://davedorman.wordpress.com blog] to explain his thoughts on creating his painting.<ref name="Anatomy" />
